OpenMW is a rewrite of the game engine. You still need to use the original game assets to play it (they are working on an original game asset to be able to ship it to platforms like android). No need for the code patch because OprnMW will have those fixes already (and if not, you can submit the code changes since all the source code is available). Not all mods are currently working, but most are. Any mods that comes in an .esm format can be applied and any graphical replacement that is a drag and drop into the Data folder will work, too (but backup everything because you never know). It uses the original assets, so if it looks better to you then odds are it's because OpenMW supports more resolutions that 4:3 ratios. No textures were changed but does support the 4k texture replacement mods.
